description: Every ISO 3166-1 country, with English and Dhivehi names and calling codes. Built by bin/build-data.php; see docs/advanced-usage/data-sources.md.

sources.code, alpha3_code, numeric_code, iso_nam: ISO 3166-1, through Debian iso-codes (https://salsa.debian.org/iso-codes-team/iso-codes) data/iso_3166-1.json, LGPL-2.1-or-later
sources.name: iso-codes common_name when it has one, else the ISO short name; inverted names are written out (sources/javaabu-country-names.en.json)
sources.dhivehi_name: iso-codes iso_3166-1/dv.po (dhivehi_name_source: iso-codes), or translated for this package (dhivehi_name_source: javaabu, for review)
